   137:             group: root
   138:             mode: "0644"
   139:             content: |
   140:               # Loaded for docker-ce's iptables/NAT bridge networking (see
   141:               # playbooks/devenv/bootstrap.yml). These live in
   142:               # kernel-modules-extra, absent from the CentOS Stream 10 golden image.
   143:               xt_addrtype
   144:               iptable_nat
   145:               br_netfilter

   150:             state: present
   151:           loop:
   152:             - xt_addrtype
   153:             - iptable_nat
   154:             - br_netfilter

   156:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   157:     # One-shot Docker data-root migration (igou-inventory#373). Only runs
   158:     # when a daemon is already up with a root dir other than
   159:     # docker_data_root: stop the devcontainer unit (its ExecStop removes
   160:     # the container, and the unit is started again at the end of this play),
   161:     # stop the daemon, copy the store, and park the old tree as
   162:     # /var/lib/docker.migrated. The docker role then renders daemon.json
   163:     # with the new data-root and starts the daemon on it; post_tasks verify

   165:     # skip straight to the role, which creates the store in place.
   166:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------

   172:       failed_when: false
   173:       become: true

   177:       when:
   178:         - devenv_docker_root.rc == 0
   179:         - devenv_docker_root.stdout | trim != docker_data_root
